name: Boeing 787 Dreamliner
summary: Carbon-composite long-haul twin flown in the US by United and American.

wings: Long, very flexible wing that bends strongly upward in flight
Smoothly raked wingtips with no winglets
engines: Two large nacelles (GEnx or Trent 1000) with sawtooth chevrons on the rear edge
fuselage: Smooth, rounded nose with only four cockpit windows
tail: Tall swept fin with a gently curved leading edge

tellTales: Wings curving upward in flight and ending in raked tips
Sawtooth serrations at the back of each engine
Smooth dolphin-like nose with four cockpit windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The 787 has raked wingtips, serrated nacelle exhausts and a four-pane windshield; the A350 has curling winglets, smooth exhausts and a black cockpit mask.
The 787 has four-wheel bogies and serrated exhausts; the 777 has six-wheel bogies, bigger smooth nacelles and a blade tailcone.
The 787 has raked wingtips, chevron exhausts and a smooth rounded nose; the 767 has a pointed nose with a six-pane windshield and often blended winglets.
